records.text: Jacob Blank wrote in an internal Utah Valley Hospital message that only Deborah and he could access the trauma patient's chart and no one else was allowed to open it; Owens presented the message as concerning Charlie Kirk
records.speaker: Jacob Blank

appearances.snippet: But then we received an email from somebody in the medical staff at UVU saying, "I'm certain that he was here, and I have a medical file." That we—in the text that we received at 2:08 p.m.—saying that "we're not allowed to touch the medical file." And here is the entry in the UVU system for Charlie Kirk. It had his right birthday, had his age, it had an MRN number. And then this individual shared the internal message that went out telling them that they're not allowed to touch the file. ... "Hi all, there was a media event that took place today that led to a trauma patient. Due to the nature of a situation, the only individuals who will be allowed in the chart will be Deborah and myself. No one else is allowed to hover or open the chart. Jacob Blank. Deb and I will be doing the log tomorrow. Thanks, and let me know if you have any questions now."

verification.notes: Unverifiable: Utah Valley Hospital internal messages are private communications. Would require hospital records or whistleblower confirmation.
